   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Mar 14, 2026 - Oct 10, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Treus626_, Oct 10, 2026, 1/5: "I am frustrated because I just signed up on this app a few days ago. So far I have only signed up for two classes. The first class I went to, the studio wasn’t even open. I had waited a while, but it was not opened even past the class time. The second one I signed up for was an 8 AM barre class at a gym. I arrive just to find out that the class actually doesn’t start sometime until after 9 AM. I was speaking with a staff member at the gym who told me that he has spoken with few people who were using Class Pass who have experienced the same issue before."
            2. _Lucía Loreto_, Oct 6, 2026, 1/5: "I had to contact them 3 times to freeze my account and yet they failed. I’m injured and can’t use the credits. They keep me on hold and don’t end up doing their job"
            3. _mattallsop_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "I have reported the issue to my bank. This app should be reviewed by Apple for breach of app store rules on billing."
